lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Speckled BandNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 33SURREY TRAGEDY: DR ROYLOTT DEAD OF A SERPENT'S BITEDr Grimesby Roylott is found dead in his chair at Stoke Moran, with a snake coiled in his lap and a small basket at his feet. He has been killed, as he intended to kill his stepdaughter, by an Indian swamp adder, the deadliest snake in India; and it has returned, as such creatures do, to the man who feeds it. The coroner records misadventure. Helen Stoner goes to her aunt at Harrow, and is married in the autumn. You tell Watson on the train that you are, indirectly, responsible for the death of Dr Grimesby Roylott, and that you cannot say that it will weigh very heavily upon your conscience. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
